scope: Public eval only; fresh in-memory graph per case; no Telegram sends or production history writes.
runtime: gpt-6-luna Responses medium; same 60s invocation /90s turn /105s bot safety budgets.
timing: Complete grounded graph answer, excluding startup and Telegram delivery.
limitations: Five fixed public questions, sequential nonrandomized cohorts with provider/cache variability; no SLA/P95 claim.
Citation ID integrity is mechanical and does not establish semantic quality.
Cancelled/failed provider usage can be billed and is unknown, never counted as zero.
v10-v12 use a private harness reset to permit two backups; v13+ use real shared per-turn limit.

A first v12 attempt was interrupted after four cases to add ordering guards; same output label was accidentally reused. Its raw answers are unavailable. Recovered stdout timings are listed separately, excluded from comparisons.
